verdict.rationale: Square provides a Catalog API for item management and a dedicated Inventory API for tracking stock, plus a Locations API supporting multi-location sellers, which together enable cross-register/channel catalog and inventory sync; marketing pages also tout 'Track inventory' and 'Manage orders from one place'. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that inventory counts stay reliably in sync in practice, and explicit documentation of real-time sync mechanics (e.g., webhooks tie-in for inventory changes) beyond API existence.
